first_divergence: Native background field/support selection. Existing measured projection, detector area and raw physical response bank unchanged.
limitations: No acquisition-matched blank supplied. Timed Pb dark remains a transfer assumption.
GD1 lowest-angle background and some local Pb controls remain poorly constrained.
Background sensitivity weights are conditional, not calibrated confidence intervals.
Rejection-audit controls were reused during development; no untouched final-test claim.
Frozen peak guards cover named retained windows and branches; they do not establish every individual peak is correct.
support_audit: Raw-image boundaries independently visually reviewed. Margin20/40/60px sensitivity stored; no residual-derived observation mask.
later_numerical_notes: Control-cell centroid approximation p95 <=0.019 count/px; small relative to unresolved background structure.
